examples.en: I want you. I want Ping'er. I want our family together. I want you to leave Ling Ling—whatever she asks, I'll give it. I want her to give my husband back.
examples.zh: 我要你，我要平儿，我要我们一家人在一起过日子。我要你离开凌玲——她有什么要求我都给，我要她把我的男人还给我。

examples.en: I can't let go of you, of this home, of letting Ping'er become a child of a single-parent family.
examples.zh: 我舍不得你，我舍不得这个家，我舍不得让平儿变成单亲家庭的孩子。
